title: Create CMake build with product identity presets and three Linux formats
description:
Create CMakeLists.txt and CMakePresets.json at the repository root so the four shell sources build as VST3, LV2, and Standalone on Linux.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, Source/PluginEditor.h, Source/PluginEditor.cpp (created by a.1 and a.2) for the exact target source list.
- ./JUCE/CMakeLists.txt and ./JUCE/extras/Build/CMake/JUCEUtils.cmake for the juce_add_plugin argument names actually supported by the pinned JUCE revision 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2, in particular PRODUCT_NAME, COMPANY_NAME, VERSION, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE, PLUGIN_CODE, BUNDLE_ID, LV2URI, FORMATS, IS_SYNTH, NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT, NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT, COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD.
- ./.gitmodules to confirm JUCE is a submodule at ./JUCE.

Implement exactly:
1. CMakeLists.txt starts with cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22) and project(ShredSpace VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX). Set CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20 and CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON.
2. add_subdirectory(JUCE) to consume the existing submodule. Do not use FetchContent, do not download JUCE, do not modify anything inside JUCE/.
3. juce_add_plugin(ShredSpace ...) with EXACTLY these binding identity values: PRODUCT_NAME "ShredSpace", COMPANY_NAME "nSpace Systems", VERSION 1.0.0, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, PLUGIN_CODE ShSp, BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shredspace, LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace, FORMATS VST3 LV2 Standalone, IS_SYNTH FALSE, NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE, NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE, COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE. These identity strings and codes are frozen; do not alter their spelling or case.
4. target_sources(ShredSpace PRIVATE Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp).
5. juce_generate_juce_header(ShredSpace) OR target_compile_definitions with JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0, JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0, JUCE_USE_CURL=0, JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0 — include those four compile definitions either way.
6. target_link_libraries(ShredSpace PRIVATE juce::juce_audio_utils juce::juce_dsp PUBLIC juce::juce_recommended_config_flags juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags).
7. enable_testing() and include(CTest) so later phases can register a console unit-test runner through CTest. Do not add any test target in this task.
8. CMakePresets.json with "version": 3 and exactly two configure presets: "linux-release" (generator Ninja or Unix Makefiles, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release, binaryDir "${sourceDir}/build/linux-release") and "windows-msvc" (generator "Visual Studio 17 2022", architecture x64, binaryDir "${sourceDir}/build/windows-msvc"). The windows-msvc preset is configuration only and is not built in this plan. Add matching build presets named linux-release and windows-msvc.

Acceptance is proven by actually configuring and building: run `cmake --preset linux-release` and `cmake --build build/linux-release` and confirm both exit zero. Because no C++ language adapter exists in the abracapocus registry, use these explicit cmake commands only — never make or cppcheck.
acceptance_criteria: CMakeLists.txt calls juce_add_plugin with PRODUCT_NAME "ShredSpace", COMPANY_NAME "nSpace Systems", VERSION 1.0.0, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, PLUGIN_CODE ShSp, BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shredspace, and LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace
CMakeLists.txt sets FORMATS VST3 LV2 Standalone and CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20
CMakeLists.txt consumes JUCE via add_subdirectory(JUCE) and does not use FetchContent or download JUCE
CMakeLists.txt target_sources lists Source/PluginProcessor.cpp and Source/PluginEditor.cpp
CMakePresets.json defines configure presets named exactly linux-release and windows-msvc, with linux-release binaryDir ${sourceDir}/build/linux-release and CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release
Only CMakeLists.txt and CMakePresets.json are created or modified by this task
forbidden_changes: create or modify any file under JUCE/
modify Source/PluginProcessor.h, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, Source/PluginEditor.h, or Source/PluginEditor.cpp
create or modify scripts/build_all.sh, .gitignore, or anything under docs/
use FetchContent, ExternalProject, or any network download to obtain JUCE
add any new third-party dependency, including Catch2 or GoogleTest
add a test target or test source files in this phase task
change the frozen identity values ShredSpace, nSpace Systems, NSPC, ShSp, com.nspacesystems.shredspace, or urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace
add AU, AAX, VST2, or Unity to FORMATS
run make or cppcheck instead of explicit cmake commands

allowed: choose Ninja or Unix Makefiles as the linux-release generator
choose between juce_generate_juce_header and direct module includes
order the CMake commands within the file
forbidden: introduce a package manager or dependency fetcher
vendor a copy of JUCE outside the submodule
add plugin formats beyond VST3, LV2, and Standalone
define a unit-test target before phase-appropriate tasks
